title: Looking for artists for comic and animation teams
content: Heyo! I’m doing an all call looking for artists to help build out my comic and animation teams! I think it’s time to try and ease up some of the stress and expand my team! author: willai3213
title: Seeking designer for exhibition visuals and character designs
content: Looking for a graphic designer to collaborate on exhibition visual design (Taipei Huashan, early December). Scope includes main visual, wordmark, character visuals (6 designs, not too complex), character standees, window stickers, banners, and other exhibition collateral, plus print proofing. Timeline Oct-Dec 2026. Seeking exhibition/graphic design experience with a hand-drawn, Japanese, warm style. Interested designers comment or DM with portfolio + quote. Contact: comment or DM @willai3213
